blocks.raw:
<Tip>
  **Open Space Memory Aid:** PD 1216 = Parks/Playgrounds are density-based
  (3.5%-9%). NBC Rule VIII = Lot-level open space (TOSL). Native plants =
  tropical adapted, less irrigation, higher resilience. Hardscape + softscape =
  balanced design. Bioretention = stormwater + green space synergy.
</Tip>
